decisions.proposal: Approve option B bounded M1 sources/sinks and owner responsibility for classification/inventory; exclude universal discovery of unknown secrets.
Approve default-deny and explicit internal/private-local attestations, ID-based legacy review without authority changes, and Windows Credential Manager as later backend with M1 adapter disabled.
Require real M2-M4 connector gates at implementation, and fresh selected-Qwen plus Windows/Ubuntu evidence before any M1 closure; no merge/deployment approval.

procedure: Owner explicitly answers each decision with ADR-025 reference.
Record verbatim owner decision reference, date and scope in separate reviewed change.
Only then consider ADR accepted and explicit acceptance/traceability revision.
Evaluate original or explicitly revised gates against new evidence before status closure.
